title: 第21章 洛珺仙 我怕你做坏事还是不问为好第22章 你怎么可以让他去修炼家族里珍藏的垃圾
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
彻底清净了。
看着倒在血泊之中，无一不是重伤昏迷的楚家子弟，围观之人无不是用一种震惊以及复杂的情绪看着那道并不算高大的身影。
震惊当然是源于对方的年轻以及实力。
复杂则是来源于他的杀伐果断和坚毅。
要是换做普通人的话，在刚才敌人的那番声泪俱下求饶，失去威胁之后，说不定就会停手了。
即便不如此，多少也会犹豫片刻。
但眼前这青年却未曾停留过半分他的拳头。
心智之坚定令人瞠目结舌。
“此人莫非是拥有特殊体质吗？那拳头之上笼罩的光芒看起来颇为的不凡啊。”
“世间之大，无奇不有，兴许只是修炼了某种我等未曾得知的功法吧。”
“也是。”
也有人注意到了叶天澜拳头上的异样之处，但却并未有过多怀疑。
正如同解释那般，这个世界太大了，奇人轶事无处不在。
却在此时，身后传来急匆匆的脚步声。
来者尽管一身素雅的留仙长裙，但那昳丽倾城的容貌却没法被遮掩住，轻而易举便吸引了全场的视线。
来者正是落后了一步的洛珺仙。
她注意到现场的惨烈情况之后，黛眉微微挑动，紧接着绷着一张娇俏脸蛋来到叶天澜面前。
见此情形，后者心中难免有些紧张，还以为要挨骂了。
不由尴尬的挠挠头，急促道：“仙儿，我是不是下手有些太重了。”
洛珺仙没好气的白了他一眼，帽檐下的美眸澄澈而明亮。

“我怎么知道，那是爷爷他们应该考虑的事情。”
“这里危险，现在你首先应该做到的是跟我回去。”
说罢就是拉着他的手转身离开，完全不顾及旁人错愕的视线。
不仅是他们，就连躺在地上原本还在哀嚎和震惊的萧家人也是不自觉的闭上了嘴巴。
大小姐，难道我们的命就不是命了吗···
两人看似简单的离去，实则在洛珺仙袖口笼罩的衣物之中，有深绿色的光芒已经在悄然升腾而起。
一直等到两人回了萧家之后，这才消散掉，不见所踪。
“仙儿，难道你就不好奇我为什么下手这么重吗？”叶天澜跑到她的面前，还是没忍住开口问道。
神色格外认真和期待。
这一段路下来可没有把他给憋的心痒痒的。
可偏偏洛珺仙就是不感兴趣似的，丝毫不提及，不询问缘由。
洛珺仙撩起耳边被微风吹散的一缕发丝，动作轻柔而温和，笑意盈盈的看着他。
“你真想知道？”
content_en:
Completely clean.
Looking at the Chu family's children lying in a pool of blood, all of them seriously injured and unconscious, the onlookers all looked at the not-so-tall figure with a kind of shock and complicated emotions.
The shock was of course due to the other party's youth and strength.
The complexity comes from his decisiveness and perseverance in killing.
If it were an ordinary person, after the enemy's tearful begging for mercy just now and the threat was gone, he might have stopped.
Even if this is not the case, there will be some hesitation for a moment.
But the young man in front of him never stopped holding his fist.
The steadfastness of his mind is astonishing.
"Does this person have a special physique? The light covering his fist looks quite extraordinary."
"The world is full of wonders. Maybe you just practiced some kind of skill that we haven't heard of before."
"Same."
Some people also noticed something strange on Ye Tianlan's fist, but they didn't have too much suspicion.
As the explanation goes, the world is too big, and strange people and anecdotes are everywhere.
But at this moment, there were hurried footsteps behind him.
Although the visitor was wearing a simple and elegant Liuxian dress, her stunning appearance could not be concealed and easily attracted the attention of everyone.
The person who came was none other than Luo Junxian, who was one step behind.
After she noticed the tragic situation at the scene, her eyebrows raised slightly, and then she came to Ye Tianlan with a pretty face.
Seeing this situation, the latter inevitably felt a little nervous and thought he was going to be scolded.
He couldn't help scratching his head in embarrassment and said hastily: "Xian'er, did I strike too hard?"
Luo Junxian rolled her eyes at him angrily, her beautiful eyes under the brim of her hat were clear and bright.
"How do I know? That's something Grandpa and the others should consider."
"It's dangerous here. The first thing you should do now is go back with me."
After saying that, she took his hand and turned to leave, completely ignoring the astonished looks of others.
Not only them, but even the Xiao family who were lying on the ground and were still wailing and shocked, unconsciously closed their mouths.
Miss, is our life not life?
The two of them seemed to be leaving simply, but in fact, deep green light was quietly rising from the clothes covered by Luo Junxian's sleeves.
It wasn't until the two of them returned to Xiao's house that they disappeared without a trace.
"Xian'er, aren't you curious why I'm so harsh?" Ye Tianlan ran up to her and still couldn't help asking.
He looked extremely serious and expectant.
This journey did not make him feel itchy.
But Luo Junxian just didn't seem interested, didn't mention it at all, and didn't ask why.
Luo Junxian lifted a strand of hair that was blown away by the breeze by her ear, her movements were gentle and gentle, and she looked at him with a smile.
"You really want to know?"
